About the Scholarship

Response_Able Futures is an Erasmus Mundus MFA that applies design practice to health and care challenges, run by a European consortium with studio-based pedagogy. Its admissions page describes the process for the next intake, where scholarship information is published with each call.

OpportunityResponse_Able Futures – Erasmus Mundus MFA in Design and Health_Care
HostResponse_Able Futures Consortium
LocationGenk (multi-country mobility), Belgium
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month for 24 months (EMJM scholarship)
Application DeadlineAdmissions process for the next intake announced on the official application page
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Response_Able Futures is an Erasmus Mundus MFA that applies design practice to health and care challenges, run by a European consortium with studio-based pedagogy. Its admissions page describes the process for the next intake, where scholarship information is published with each call.

Programme Highlights

  • MFA-level design programme focused on health and care contexts
  • Studio and fieldwork approach across consortium campuses
  • Scholarship details announced with each admissions call
  • Graduates work in healthcare innovation, service design and social sectors

Who Should Apply

Design graduates and practitioners from product, service, graphic and social design, as well as healthcare professionals with design interest; portfolios are central.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus funding for selected students per the consortium's admission round.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the admissions-process section on the official site and prepare a portfolio aligned with care-focused design practice. Key deadline information: Admissions process for the next intake announced on the official application page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Response_Able Futures Consortium

The Response_Able Futures consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus MFA in Design and Health_Care, combining European design schools and healthcare partners in studio-based education.

Official website: https://www.response-able-futures.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See official page for dates - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
